results.label: 1-year, 15m, short-history, EXPLORATORY

feeBps.note: X1 and the rule, stop, or window-end exit are taker legs. Dollar net uses the same bps, charged on entry notional.

sizing.costNote: Two taker legs. The spread stays in the fill.

results.intrabar: stop first; A's daily chandelier moves after the 15m bar that completes the UTC day
results.trail: highest daily close since entry minus 3 times that day's Wilder ATR14
results.stops: A's initial stop and B's disaster stop use daily Wilder ATR14. The 1h Wilder ATR14 is only the stop-fill deduction.
results.nLabel: after slots, caps, clusters, and halts

bootstrap.blocks: non-overlapping 7-day blocks aligned to Monday 00:00 UTC
bootstrap.zeroTradeWeeks: counted as $0 in the dollar bounds
bootstrap.bounds: U80 is p80 and L80 is p20

purge.rule: A trade belongs to its entry fold. IS trades open at the OOS boundary are dropped from both and counted. OOS trades are scored to their real exit. A trade open at the window end is marked to the last 15m close and flagged. Embargo is 0.

selection.statistic: highest L80 of IS mean net dollars per month at fixed caps
selection.tieBreak: higher IS total net dollars after rounding to $0.01, then registration order

concentration.gross: share of the sum of gross dollars

blocked.note: A rejected attempt increments every gate that failed. The beta cap was not applied.

holm.pValue: one-sided t test that mean OOS gross bps is above zero, on the selected book

maxOfN.note: 7 is the registered trial count. It is not a choice among the six A configs.

questions: The registration caps BTC-beta-weighted notional at $6,000 and does not define beta. The beta cap was not applied.
Halt and backstop dollars are checked on realized net dollars. Open trades are not marked, and a trip blocks new entries without flattening. The registration does not say otherwise.

The historical Holm family is [A, B], so its first critical value is 0.05/2 = 0.025. Pass or fail is adjusted p below 0.05. The first step 0.01 is the forward family's alpha/5, and that comparison is reported separately.
A is chosen once, on the single registered IS window. The registration does not give each OOS month its own IS window.
Open risk is units times the distance from the entry fill to the current stop. Gross notional is the entry notional. Sizing cost is 180 bps, two taker legs.

Clusters are recomputed at 00:00 UTC on the first day of each month from in-window daily returns before that day. A pair links at rho >= 0.8 on 60 shared return dates, by single linkage. A boundary-saved name with fewer than 60 in-window days stays alone.

The pair backstop uses that pair's cumulative realized loss. The weekly halt uses Monday 00:00 UTC weeks. The daily halt is checked before the daily backstop, so a day that has already halted does not also increment the backstop as the only reason; both counters increment when both are true.
